Build the inventory: every table and column with counts and freshness

Source: R/inventory.R
db_inventory.Rd

Artefact 1 of the roadmap. Combines db_tables(), db_columns(), db_row_counts(), db_freshness() and db_table_sizes() into one call that needs only SELECT permission on the objects.

Usage

db_inventory(
  con,
  schema = NULL,
  include = NULL,
  exclude = NULL,
  views = TRUE,
  row_counts = TRUE,
  freshness = TRUE,
  sizes = TRUE,
  dialect = NULL,
  progress = interactive()
)

Arguments

con

A DBIConnection.

schema

Optional character vector of schema names to keep.

include, exclude

Optional regular expressions matched (case insensitively) against "schema.table". A table is kept if it matches any include pattern and no exclude pattern.

views

Keep views as well as base tables? Default TRUE.

row_counts, freshness, sizes

Switch off the slower steps if needed.

dialect

Optional dialect override, see db_dialect().

progress

Show progress bars? Default TRUE in interactive use.

Value

A list of class db_inventory with two tibbles: tables (one row per table or view, with n_columns, row_count, size_bytes, newest_datetime, newest_datetime_column, inventoried_at) and columns (one row per column, see db_columns()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
con <- fakehospdata::fh_connect("sample")
inv <- db_inventory(con, include = "pas_", progress = FALSE)
inv$tables[, c("table_name", "n_columns", "row_count", "newest_datetime")]
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
} # }
